physicalNotes: Radius 1.51 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract): 1,050,507 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.39 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6600 +/- 100 K from Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
